notes_for_editor: Build date conflicts: the 1920s log cupola cabin (firelookout.com, which also says 1940s pole platform still there) versus partly complete in August 1929 (Pend Oreille Review, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page) versus built in the 1930s by the CCC (1962 Sandpoint News Bulletin, quoted there). Not resolved in the story. The dates also differ on use: the 1962 report says not used since 1950, while the site pages date abandonment to 1962. Location conflict on the record: FFLA point 48.5622, -116.14932 versus idaho_fl point 48.5641, -116.16046, about 850 m apart; the record point is kept and no correction is proposed. The web search returned a Wikipedia article titled Buck Mountain Lookout Tower that was not opened and is not used here. No staffing dates beyond 1933 were found.
